name: Bolna
description: Bolna is a multilingual Voice AI platform for Indian enterprises, enabling human-like voice agents for high-volume inbound/outbound calls in 10+ languages including Hindi. Features include <300ms latency, interruption handling, no-code builder, and integrations with ASR/LLM models. It handles customer support, e-commerce recovery, logistics COD, and recruitment. With 1,050+ paying customers, 200K+ daily interactions, and revenue growth, it scales efficiently for BFSI and logistics. Bengaluru-based with strong enterprise pipeline. Stage: Seed ($6.3M led by General Catalyst).
